acceptance.check: In a live (unarchived) group, confirming Leave group with a non-zero balance shows the balance refusal with a Settle up link to /groups/<id>#debts-heading; in an archived group the same refusal shows the refusal plus one read-only note and no link; a zero-balance leave still succeeds in both cases.
acceptance.how_to_verify: Carry a balance in a live group, press Leave group and confirm: refusal plus Settle up link, follow it to the debts section. Archive the group and repeat: refusal plus read-only note, no link. Settle to zero and leave: success unchanged, including from an archived group.

acceptance.check: An archived members screen shows no invite-sharing copy and no invite actions: no solo-owner EmptyState, no invite input, Copy, Rotate or Disable controls, and no invite notice slot; it shows one read-only sentence and the archived seats note. Unarchived solo-owner and multi-member screens are unchanged.
acceptance.how_to_verify: Archive a solo-owner group and open its members screen: no 'Share the invite link' copy, no invite actions or notices, only the read-only sentence and the archived seats note. Unarchived solo-owner still shows the EmptyState with its working action.

acceptance.check: Saving the profile shows 'Profile saved.' inline with no URL param; submitting an empty display name afterwards shows only the inline field errors; fixing the name and saving again shows the saved sentence with the fresh values; a direct hit on /profile?saved=1 or /profile?error=invalid renders the matching legacy notice, and forged values (?saved=yes, ?error=lol) render nothing.
acceptance.how_to_verify: Save profile: saved sentence appears, URL stays /profile. Submit an empty display name: field error shows, saved notice gone. Fix the name and save: saved sentence returns with the new name. Load /profile?error=invalid directly: refusal sentence renders. Load /profile?saved=yes: nothing renders.

acceptance.check: A remove success notice (?removed=) never sits beside a later inline leave refusal in the same members section, and cancelling the leave confirm restores the removal note.
acceptance.how_to_verify: Remove a member (lands on ?removed=Name), then press Leave group and confirm while carrying a balance: the balance refusal shows without the stale 'Removed …' sentence above it. Cancel the confirm: the removal note is visible again.

alternatives_considered.approach: Leave refusal: redirect with a notice query param instead of an inline link.
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: Refusals must stay inline because the form stays mounted (ADR-0008); a redirect would remount the panel and discard the confirm context.

alternatives_considered.approach: Archived solo-owner: write new archived-specific EmptyState copy instead of suppressing it.
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: The read-only seats note directly below already says what an archived group needs; a second sentence restating it is copy to maintain for no new information.

alternatives_considered.approach: Profile staleness: clear the query param from the client (router.replace on refusal) and keep the notice on the page.
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: The notice is painted before the island hydrates so both sentences flash together, and it adds navigation side effects to a refusal; an inline success removes the stale param at the source instead.

alternatives_considered.approach: Leave the InvitePanel's link, Copy, Rotate and Disable controls live on archived groups and scope AC-2 to the EmptyState only.
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: Every one of those controls is dead on an archived group (join filters archived out, rotate/disable return ARCHIVED_STATE), so AC-2's read-only screen could not be verified.

alternatives_considered.approach: Export MembersScreen from members/page.tsx as the test seam.
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: Next.js rejects any named export but metadata/default from a page file at build time, and all 11 page files in this repo export only those; the screen moves to components/ instead.

alternatives_considered.approach: Keep updateProfile's success redirect and gate the moved notice on island error state.
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: The island's error state survives the same-URL redirect, so a refusal-then-fix-then-save would suppress the saved confirmation it just earned and repaint refused values over saved ones.

work_order.approach: Seven edits plus a component move, each reusing the helper the sibling path already uses. (1) In MembersPanel, mirror the remove path beside leaveState (leaveBlocked = isBalanceBlockedRefusal(leaveState.message)) but gate the Settle up link on !archived, because leaving is the one write an archived group still accepts (lib/groups/actions.ts:393-395) while settling in one is refused (lib/settle/actions.ts:101,190); when blocked-and-archived render the refusal plus one read-only note naming that the balance cannot be settled here, never a link. Gate removedNotice on a local leaveFailed flag set from leaveState errors and cleared when the confirm is cancelled, so a cancelled refusal restores the true removal note. (2) Move MembersScreen and SoloOwnerAction unchanged into components/members-screen.tsx so the test seam is importable without adding a page export Next rejects; members/page.tsx stays a thin server wrapper. Gate the solo-owner EmptyState on soloOwner && !group.archived (fixes the issue's findings 2 and 4, the same render stated twice), pass archived through to InvitePanel, and pass no inviteNotice when archived. Give InvitePanel an archived prop that renders one read-only sentence in place of the notice slot, link input, Copy, captions, Rotate and Disable controls. (3) Profile: add PROFILE_SAVED_MESSAGE and a closed-vocabulary profileNoticeText beside inviteNoticeText (saved==='1', error==='invalid', error first, arrays and everything else null); updateProfile answers success inline with that message (revalidatePath kept, redirect dropped) because this form does not unmount on success so ADR-0008's redirect rationale does not apply — recorded deviation; the page reads params through the validator and passes the notice plus email into ProfileForm; the notice slot and Card move into the island together so idle markup position is preserved; the island renders the success sentence on success, the param notice when idle, and null whenever its action state holds a refusal. No server sentence changes outside the profile success transport, so the lib/groups/actions.test.ts:850 settle-up pin stays green; lib/auth/actions.test.ts:331-334 is updated to the inline success.
assumptions: The #debts-heading anchor on the group page is the correct settle-up target for a leaver in a live group.

Suppressing the archived solo-owner EmptyState satisfies the read-only wording requirement because the seats note below already carries it, and an archived multi-member group already renders with just that note, so solo becomes consistent with it.

Reproduction is branch-level on the current post-#44 checkout (HEAD afcdc32, no later round touched these renders): each finding was confirmed by executing its exact faulty branch and observing the faulty output recorded in evidence, with code citations as the second leg. No browser-driven reproduction was performed in planning; the driven confirmation is the browser acceptance walk for each AC, which QA performs. The four defects are unambiguous in code, so a driven pass is verification, not diagnosis.
work_order.confidence_rationale: Every diagnosis was re-verified against the code cited, each fix reuses an existing helper or one-line condition at a site with exactly one caller, and the critique's two load-bearing objections (invalid page export, surviving island error state) are designed out rather than patched. What keeps this at 78 rather than 90 is that the leave-link and removed-notice conditions are unreachable from any static test seam so AC-1 and AC-4 rest on the browser walk, and the inline-success transport deviates from ADR-0008 and needs a reviewer's explicit nod.
work_order.debate_summary: The critique was right on the blocking finding and both majors, and they reshaped the plan. Blocking (named export from page.tsx): verified — all 11 page files export only metadata plus default, so the seam moves to components/members-screen.tsx instead. Major (island error state survives the redirect): verified — the redirect throws so useActionState never leaves 'error', and the pre- and post-save URLs are the identical string, so no key or remount can reset it; the plan now answers profile success inline (the form never unmounts, so ADR-0008's rationale does not apply) with the refusal-then-fix-then-save walk added to AC-3 and qa_script, at the cost of updating the actions.test.ts redirect pin and recording the deviation. Major (archived leave is a dead end): verified — archiving has no zero-balance precondition while leave keeps its guard and settling refuses archived, so the plan keeps the gated link for live groups, writes honest archived copy that promises no way out, and records the stuck member plus the group-page banner's overpromise as an explicit residual product decision. Major (reproduced overstated): factually right — the evidence was branch execution, not a driven app — but a full browser drive is unsatisfiable in the planning step, so reproduced stays true with the standard stated plainly in assumptions and the driven confirmation assigned to acceptance. Of the minors: AC-2 now excludes the retained invite notice too (suppressed on archived screens) and the residual names ui.md:217/220/223; the group-page expense/rename and invite notice/refusal sibling pairs are scoped out in writing rather than silently ignored; the inviteNoticeText citation is corrected to actions.test.ts:129; the removedNotice gate is bound to a cancel-clearable flag instead of permanent state. The repeated-params type lie is absorbed by giving the new validator an unknown-accepting signature that returns null for arrays.

issue_snapshot.title: Follow-ups from #37: 4 from the review
issue_snapshot.body:
What the review and QA of PR #44 (for #37) found and did not fix there — filed as it merged, one ticket for the lot.

## From the review

Non-blocking findings the reviewer approved despite: a statement about severity, not a judgement that they are wrong.

### A leave blocked by a non-zero balance names the blocker but offers no settle-up link, while the identical refusal on remove does.

> A leave blocked by a non-zero balance names the blocker but offers no settle-up link, while the identical refusal on remove does.
> 
> `components/groups-panels.tsx`
> 
> Evidence: leaveGroup returns the same NonZeroBalanceError sentence as removeMember (lib/groups/actions.ts:405 vs :355), but MembersPanel renders only `<StateMessage state={leaveState} />` (components/groups-panels.tsx:707) with no isBalanceBlockedRefusal check, while RemoveMemberForm checks it (:468) and renders the Settle up link to /groups/<id>#debts-heading (:491; anchor exists at app/groups/[id]/page.tsx:320). Repro: carry a balance, press Leave group and confirm: the refusal names the blocker with no way onward.
> 
> Fix: Mirror the remove path beside leaveState: const leaveBlocked = isBalanceBlockedRefusal(leaveState.message) and render the same Settle up link when true.

### An archived solo-owner group shows invite-sharing empty-state copy for a link that cannot work.

> An archived solo-owner group shows invite-sharing empty-state copy for a link that cannot work.
> 
> `app/groups/[id]/members/page.tsx`
> 
> Evidence: SoloOwnerAction returns null when group.archived (app/groups/[id]/members/page.tsx:234), so the EmptyState renders with no action, yet its body (:191) still says 'Share the invite link and the rest can join — or add somebody by name below if they have not signed up'. Archived groups refuse join/rotate/disable writes (ARCHIVED_STATE in lib/groups/actions.ts) and the same screen says seats cannot be added (:200), so both suggested actions fail and the read-only wording AC-2 requires is not what the empty state says.
> 
> Fix: When group.archived, give the solo-owner EmptyState read-only copy instead of the invite-sharing sentence (or suppress the EmptyState for archived groups, since the seats note already covers it).

### A ?saved=1 success notice from an earlier save stays on screen beside a later inline refusal: the page renders the notice from searchParams at server render, and the island refusal navigates nowhere, so 'Profile saved.' and fresh field errors show at once.

> A ?saved=1 success notice from an earlier save stays on screen beside a later inline refusal: the page renders the notice from searchParams at server render, and the island refusal navigates nowhere, so 'Profile saved.' and fresh field errors show at once.
> 
> `app/profile/page.tsx:39`
> 
> Evidence: git show pr44:app/profile/page.tsx lines 39-44: notice derives from searchParams (?saved=1/?error=invalid) and renders in the role=status slot; git show pr44:components/profile-form.tsx:38: refusal returns inline via useActionState with no navigation, so the param (and its notice) survives the refusal render. On main (git show main:lib/auth/actions.ts) a refusal redirected to /profile?error=invalid, which replaced the param — this staleness is new with the inline transport.
> 
> Fix: Pass the saved/error flags into ProfileForm (or lift the notice into the island) and suppress the query-param notice once the action state holds a refusal (state.status === 'error'), so the page never claims 'Profile saved.' beside fresh field errors.

### An archived group with only its owner shows a 'Share the invite link' empty state with no action: the solo-owner EmptyState ignores group.archived, and SoloOwnerAction returns null for archived groups, leaving share-the-link copy directly above the archived read-only note.

> An archived group with only its owner shows a 'Share the invite link' empty state with no action: the solo-owner EmptyState ignores group.archived, and SoloOwnerAction returns null for archived groups, leaving share-the-link copy directly above the archived read-only note.
> 
> `app/groups/[id]/members/page.tsx:187`
> 
> Evidence: git show pr44:app/groups/[id]/members/page.tsx:109: soloOwner is isOwner && members.length === 1 with no archived condition; lines 187-193 render the EmptyState ('Share the invite link and the rest can join') unconditionally on it; SoloOwnerAction (lines 227-234) returns null when group.archived, so the archived solo group gets the sharing copy, no action, then the line-196 'archived, so seats cannot be added' note.
> 
> Fix: Render the solo-owner EmptyState only when !group.archived, or give archived solo groups their own sentence that points at the read-only note instead of the invite link.

---

**Check each one still reproduces before planning it.** They were written against the PR as it stood, and a later round can have fixed one. Some may not hold up: say so and drop them rather than implementing something that was never wrong. Split this if they turn out to be unrelated.

Depends on #37.
